_about: Candidate AGY_IDENTITIES_JSON entries for the canonical hosted staging service (agy-temporal-staging). Tokens are PLACEHOLDERS: real values are generated server-side at provisioning and Muse's token reaches Muse only through the Secure Vault page for its connector. identitiesFromEnv (src/platform/auth.ts) validates this shape and fails closed on malformed entries or token collisions. Scopes use the canonical project scope seeded by the repo (tenant gl / workspace legacy-workspace / project GL_AUTOMATION).
_notes: The reviewer identity is separate from the worker identity: TemporalGateway.submit_qa enforces SELF_QA_DENIED when reviewer subject/workerId equals the executor.
Gemini's tokens are provisioned to Gemini's own tooling (browser adapter route); Muse never holds them.
Removing an entry (and redeploying) revokes that principal immediately; setting the matching agy_connectors row enabled=false unbinds the worker from allocation without touching identities.
